biggest_catch: This is TIERED, not a flat payout: your friend must hit Advantage relationship milestones within 90 days of opening - you earn $50 when they reach Advantage Plus Rewards status, $50 more if they hold $10,000+ in aggregate deposits, and $100 more if they take out $5,000+ in personal loans. If the friend qualifies for none of these, you earn $0. Not available in Wisconsin.
catches: Friend must be a NEW Advia member (not previously a member) who qualifies for Advia field of membership and follows the referral program instructions.

Friend must open and maintain qualifying Advantage Relationship(s) within 90 days of new account opening: (1) $50 when reaching Advantage Plus Rewards status (see adviacu.org/advantageplus); and/or (2) $50 when accruing $10,000+ in new aggregate deposits held; and/or (3) $100 when obtaining $5,000+ in aggregate personal loans (auto/RV or signature loan balances).

Referral bonus payout(s) paid in one sum via deposit into the Primary Share Savings of both the referring member and the qualifying new member, no more than 45 days after the first 3 months of membership.
Both accounts must be in good standing (no delinquent loan, no charged-off account, no negative share balance) at time of payment.
May not be combined with other promotional offers; individuals may not refer themselves; subject to change or discontinuation at any time.
Bonus may be reported to the IRS; taxes are the recipient's responsibility.

steps: Visit the Advia referral page and complete the referral form with your information (name, phone, email matching your member account).
Share your referral link with friends/family via email or social media.
Friend informs Advia you referred them when opening their account (or within 90 days) and hits Advantage milestones within 90 days of account opening.
You receive the tiered referral incentive ($50-$200) deposited to your Primary Share Savings within 45 days after the friend's first 3 months of membership.
